findings.claim: The existing AddressBookDeletedEventSchema was rewritten to reuse AddressBookEntrySchema, an opportunistic cleanup outside the task's stated scope, which the PR description only records as adding entries to the enum for this file; it should be restored to its original payload definition, leaving only the two new request event schemas as additions.

This spec file has no behavioural change, only a blank line and a single-use 'decrypted' intermediate variable, and is unrelated to the audit-log change and not listed in the PR description; it should be reverted to its base-branch content.

The new reject/create test cases hard-code the asserted contact name as "Alice" even though no assertion depends on that exact value, while the sibling entity spec in the same PR uses faker for it; it should use faker.person.fullName() and pass that value consistently at both sites.
